chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far عليه السلام to order a shirt for me which I would prepare for my shroud. So he sent it to me. I said: “How should I proceed?” He said: “Remove its buttons.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام, the authority being asked for instruction
key_terms.أَزْرَارَهُ: its buttons, which are to be taken off the garment
key_terms.بِقَمِيصٍ: a shirt intended to be prepared for burial use
key_terms.كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ: how should I proceed; a request for practical instruction
key_terms.لِكَفَنِي: for my shroud, meaning for use in burial wrapping

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام instruct regarding preparing a shirt for use in a burial shroud?
ai.summary: This hadith relates an instruction from Imam Aba Ja'far عليه السلام regarding preparing a shirt for use as a burial shroud. It indicates a practical legal ruling about how such a garment should be readied, specifically by removing its buttons.
